title: Chronicles of Crime
subtitle: An app-driven cooperative criminal investigation series blending physical board play and digital forensics
tagline: Scan clues, interrogate suspects, and crack London's most baffling cases.
loreSummary: As seasoned Scotland Yard detectives operating in modern-day London, you and your investigative team work against the clock to solve gruesome crimes, analyze scientific evidence with forensics specialists, and bring ruthless perpetrators to justice.
keyFeatures: Scan&Play QR-code integration connecting cards, suspect interviews, and crime scene locations
Panoramic 3D and VR crime scene examinations discovering crucial physical clues
Dynamic in-game clock where every interrogation, travel, and forensic consultation consumes time
Specialist contacts at Scotland Yard providing hacker, medical examiner, and criminologist insights
